relation_graph.unmapped_note: The dominant unresolved family is the already-documented ISDF_outro missing-root source gap; do not cross-bind similarly named roots from other groups.

conclusion: Material-level code401 cannot be modeled solely as a 2D transform on serialized HRC TEXCOORD_0. A material's live Softimage texture projection must remain reconstructable because 1,047 mapped class-4 models (1,085 texture attachments) have polygon UV corners whose serialized U/V values are entirely zero, and those records retain meaningful projection-type state across codes 1 through 8.
official_semantic_constraint: Softimage Texture.GetTransformValues calculates final UVW from Material.CurrentUV together with Texture Projection Definition, texture shader and ImageClip effects. The archive therefore needs two source-coordinate paths: preserve usable authored/current UVs where present, and reconstruct the live projection generator when the serialized UV source is absent/zero.
production_requirements: Do not apply code401 matrix state as only KHR_texture_transform on all-zero UVs; that cannot create the missing base projection.
For class4 zero-UV cases, recover the projection generator before applying matrix/repeat/remap/crop/wrap effects.

For class4 nonzero-UV cases, retain the serialized UVs as a candidate CurrentUV source and apply only independently proven live texture effects; do not overwrite them merely because a projection code is present.
Class10/NURBS code401 attachments require the NURBS parameterization/projection path and are tracked separately.
